integrity: The bounded-operator Taylor identities and invariant Jacobi block decomposition prove the result; the standalone numerical checker corroborates nonstandard identities in 3378 categorized assertion groups. No third-party or formal independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A two-sided infinite bounded self-adjoint single-particle diamond chain with nonzero bonds on all four sides of every diamond; no direct hub-hub or arm-arm coupling.
The criterion is for every-time confinement of each hub within its own two neighboring arm pairs, not generalized compact localization in arbitrary geometries.
Under inhomogeneous disorder the spectral type is pure point, but the closure of the eigenvalues can have nonisolated points.
Leading leakage orders concern transitions between neighboring hubs and do not give noise robustness or long-time delocalization rates.
Closely related earlier flat-band detangling and symmetric-arm cases are acknowledged; residual scientific priority uncertainty remains.
title: Exact disorder criterion and leakage orders for Aharonov–Bohm diamond cages
